checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a score-to-audio verification command

impact_assessment.why: There is no direct way to confirm that a WAV still matches its source score after a chain of edits or effects.
impact_assessment.benefits: verify re-renders a score with the current settings and compares bytes to a WAV, reporting the first differing byte for deterministic diagnosis.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a matching file must pass, a single-byte change must be located exactly, and usage/IO errors must use distinct exit codes; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure comparison helper with exact byte-offset tests, a CLI command reusing the render path, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 224 tests green; verify match, byte-offset mismatch and exit codes pinned by tests
Task 'coda-verify' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: 107fe11dc23f1f54a0308f77da6375a0ddea818a

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a CODA provenance chunk in WAV files

impact_assessment.why: Rendered audio carries no record of its source; a stamp makes each WAV explain which score digest produced it.
impact_assessment.benefits: stamp appends a small CODA chunk with score digest, note count and tempo, and stamp-info reads it back, without disturbing audio data.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the RIFF size must be updated, audio bytes must be unchanged, missing chunks must report cleanly, and invalid WAVs must fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure stamp module with round-trip and header byte tests, two CLI commands, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 229 tests green; CODA chunk round-trip, RIFF size and unchanged audio bytes pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-stamp' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: bd8ab518513eeb3b76b5786c973f54c00485357b

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add configurable MIDI time-signature meta event

impact_assessment.why: Exported MIDI carries tempo but no meter, so DAWs assume 4/4 even for waltzes.
impact_assessment.benefits: --time-signature 3/4 writes a standard FF 58 meta event at tick 0 in exported MIDI, while omitting it keeps existing bytes unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the meta event bytes must be exact, denominators must be powers of two, and the default must not change golden MIDI vectors; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a byte-vector test for the meta event, extend MIDI export with an optional signature, wire the CLI option, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 231 tests green; FF 58 meta bytes exact, default unchanged, invalid meters rejected
Task 'coda-midi-timesig' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: 8dc74d6f94c54f9f1007c6d8cb953120053cfb8c

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a deterministic Markdown report command

impact_assessment.why: Score stats, lint, fingerprint and audio analysis live in separate commands; a single report makes a piece explain itself in one artifact.
impact_assessment.benefits: report combines score digest, stats, lint findings and optional audio analysis into a byte-stable Markdown document.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the report format must be exactly reproducible, missing audio must be handled cleanly, and invalid inputs must fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure report module with exact golden-string tests, a CLI command reusing existing analyzers, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 236 tests green; report sections, lint wording and determinism pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-report' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add stereo width control

impact_assessment.why: Pan and channel ops exist, but the stereo image width cannot be narrowed or widened without an external processor.
impact_assessment.benefits: width uses mid/side math so amount 0 folds to mono, 1 is byte-identical, and values above 1 widen the image deterministically.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: amount 1 must be an identity within 16-bit quantization, invalid amounts must fail clearly, and length/rate must be preserved; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure mid/side module with exact frame-vector tests, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 241 tests green; width 0 mono, 1 identity, widening clamp pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-width' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add decibel-based WAV gain

impact_assessment.why: Needs a simple level trim in dB without re-rendering from the score; normalization only targets peak or RMS.
impact_assessment.benefits: gain applies an exact linear factor from dB to a Coda WAV, with 0 dB byte-identical and clamping handled deterministically.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: 0 dB must be an identity, -6 dB must halve amplitude within quantization, invalid WAVs must fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure gain module with exact byte tests, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 246 tests green; 0 dB identity and -6.0206 dB halving pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-gain' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add DC-offset removal for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: Recorded or synthesized audio can carry a constant offset that wastes headroom; no Coda tool removes it.
impact_assessment.benefits: dc measures the per-channel mean and subtracts it deterministically, with zero-mean input left byte-identical.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the mean must be computed over all frames, zero-mean input must be an identity within quantization, and invalid WAVs must fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure DC module with exact byte tests using a known offset signal, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 250 tests green; DC removal identity and known-offset byte tests pass
